flows.title: Download a statement
steps: Stop and ask the person before continuing when Wise asks for the download to be confirmed: that step asks them to confirm their identity, which only they can do. Type nothing into it.
On the website, click your initials in the top corner and select Statements and reports, then Statements.

Select Create a statement, and choose the currencies or jars, the time period, the file format and the language. One statement covers at most 365 days; for longer, create one per period. For accounting statements, tick the box to show fees separately.
Hand the confirmation to the person. Once they have confirmed it, statements made this way appear in the Custom tab.
stops: typing the person's password or any other credential into the box Wise shows for a download

flows.title: Download a list of transfers
steps: On the website's Home page, next to Transactions, select See all. This is not available in the mobile app.
Use Filter to narrow the list by date, recipient, type, status, direction, category or currency, or use the search bar.
Click Download and choose CSV or PDF to get the current view, covering up to 365 days.
